title: Extended group analysis and conservation laws of a class of variable coefficient generalized Kawahara equations
summary: We review and extend the results on the group analysis of a class of generalized Kawahara equations with time-dependent coefficients. First, we provide an overview of the existing literature on Lie symmetries and Lie-invariant solutions of such equations. We then present a complete description of their transformation properties, including admissible, equivalence, and Lie symmetry transformations.
